title: Clinical Performance of LAMP Compared to RT-PCR for COVID-19 Diagnosis
author: Mizushima, Ryo
materials: The protocol, informed consent forms, recruitment materials, and all subject materials were reviewed and approved by the Ethical Review Committee of each site and the National Center for Global Health and Medicine in Japan before any subject was enrolled in the study (NCGM-G-004100-00). This study was conducted in accordance with the International Council for Harmonisation Good Clinical Practice guidelines. All subjects provided informed consent prior to study participation.

Nasopharyngeal swabs were collected from all the subjects. The specimens were suspended in a virus transport medium (VTM) and transferred to the laboratory for RNA extraction using a QIAamp Viral RNA kit (QIAGEN, Hilden, Germany). In Indonesia, specimens were collected using a Virus Transport Kit (2 mL; Jinan Babio Tech, Jinan, China), whereas in the Philippines, Bioteke VTM (3 mL; BioTeke Corporation, Wuxi, China) was used.

steps.title: Collect swab and suspend in VTM
steps.instruction: Collect a nasopharyngeal swab from each subject and place it into the appropriate virus transport medium (VTM). Use the 2 mL Virus Transport Kit (Jinan Babio Tech, Jinan, China) for specimens collected in Indonesia and the 3 mL Bioteke VTM (BioTeke Corporation, Wuxi, China) for specimens collected in the Philippines. Transport the VTM‑containing samples to the laboratory for further processing.

substeps.instruction: Insert swab into the correct VTM (2 mL or 3 mL depending on country).
Label and transport to the laboratory.

steps.title: Extract RNA from VTM
steps.instruction: Extract viral RNA from the VTM using the QIAamp Viral RNA kit (QIAGEN, Hilden, Germany) following the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Prepare LAMP reaction mixture
steps.instruction: In a reaction tube combine 10 µL of extracted RNA with 15 µL of the Loopamp™ SARS‑CoV‑2 Detection Kit master mix (which contains the primer set) to obtain a final volume of 25 µL.

steps.title: Incubate LAMP and measure turbidity
steps.instruction: Incubate the 25 µL LAMP mixture at 62.5 °C for 35 min. After incubation invert the tube for 2 min, mix five times, briefly spin down, and then measure turbidity with the Loopamp EXIA real‑time turbidimeter (Eiken Chemical Co., Ltd.).

steps.title: Prepare RT‑PCR reaction
steps.instruction: Set up the RT‑PCR reaction using the extracted RNA. Include a synthetic RNA positive control (containing an artificial sequence) to monitor for contamination and distilled water as a negative control.

steps.title: Run RT‑PCR thermal program
steps.instruction: Run the RT‑PCR with the following program: 50 °C for 30 min, then 95 °C for 15 min; followed by cycling of 15 s at 95 °C and 1 min at 60 °C for each cycle (up to 40 cycles). A sample is considered positive if amplification occurs within 40 cycles.

steps.title: Interpret assay results
steps.instruction: Interpret LAMP results according to the turbidity reading criteria provided by the manufacturer. For RT‑PCR, declare a sample positive when a signal is detected within the 40‑cycle threshold.

steps.title: Staff training and blinding
steps.instruction: Ensure all personnel performing the LAMP and RT‑PCR assays have completed the online training for the LAMP method; note that the staff are not blinded to sample identity during testing.
